name: Don't Flex On Me, Yumi-Chan!!!
source:
A story of young love between a couple of twenty-somethings.

Play the role of a slacker who has the chance of a lifetime when his childhood friend comes back into his life, but transformed into a buff and bossy goth girl!
translation:
讲述了一对二十多岁的情侣之间的青春爱情故事。

扮演一个懒鬼的角色，当他儿时的朋友回到他的生活时，他本有千载难逢的机会，但却变成了一个健壮而专横的哥特女孩！
